A new EU/international Action Plan for the Turtle Dove (http://ec.europa.eu/environment/nature/conservation/wildbirds/hunting/docs/20181002%20Final_draft_European%20TurtleDove.pdf) was approved in May 2018. The action plan identifies the following 3 main threats to the species:1) Habitat loss;2) Illegal killing and trapping;3) Unsustainable hunting levels.The contract aims to set up an adaptive harvest management modelling framework, for each flyway, in accordance with Action 3.2.1 of the Action Plan.
